paite: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
heading: Adam A Kipan Noah Suante / (Gen 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)

paite: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared;
Enok, Methuselah, Lamekh;
Noah, Shem, Ham leh Japheth.
Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
heading: Japheth Suante

paite: Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath, leh Togarmah ahi uh.
Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, leh Rodanim ahi uh.
Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, leh Put, Kanaan ahi uh.
heading: Ham Suante

paite: Kus tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Seba, leh Dedan ahi uh.
Kush in Nimrod asuang a; amah lei ah mihat ahong hi pan hi.
Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lahabte, Naphtuhte,
Pathruste, Kasluhte, Philistiate hong kipatna leh Kaphtorte asuang hi.
Kanaan in Zidon ata masapen leh Heth asuang a;
Jebus mi, Amor mi, Girgas mi;
Hiv mi, Arki mi, Sin mi.
Arvad mi, Zemar mi leh Hamath mi leng asuang hi.
Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, leh Meshek.
heading: Shem Suante

paite: Arpakshad in Shelah asuang a, huan Shelah in Eber asuang hi.
Eber lak ah tapa nih apiang ua: khat pen min Peleg ahi (adam lai in lah lei akikhen ngal a), a-unaupa min Joktan ahi.
Joktan in Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
Ebal, Abimael, Sheba;
Ophir, Havilah, leh Jobab asuang hi. Hiaite tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;
Eber, Peleg, Reu;
Serug, Nahor, Terah;
Abram, huai mah Abraham ahi.
Abraham tapate: Isak leh Ishmael ahi.
heading: Abraham Suante / (Gen 25.12-16)

paite: Hiaite akhang kizopdan uh ahi: Ishmael ta masapen Nebajoth ahi. Huan Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
Mishma, Dumah, Massa; Hadad, Tema,
Jetur, Naphish, leh Kedemah. Hiaite Ishmael tapate ahi uh.
Keturah, Abraham mei tapate: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, leh Shuah ahi. Jokshan tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
Midian tapate: Ephah, Epher, Honok, Abida, leh Eldaah ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Keturah suante ahi uh.
Abraham in Isak asuang hi. Isak tapate: Esau leh Israel ahi uh.
Esau tapate: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, leh Korah ahi uh.
heading: Esau Suante / (Gen 36.1-19)

paite: Eliphaz tapate: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, leh Amalek ahi uh.
Reuel tapate: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, leh Mizzah ahi uh.
Seir tapate: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar leh Dishan ahi uh.
heading: Edom Gam Mi Masate / (Gen 36.20-30)

paite: Lotan tapate: Hori leh Homam; leh Lotan sanggamnu Timna ahi uh.
Shobal tapate: Alian, Manahath leh Ebal, Shephi leh Onam ahi uh. Huan Zibeon tapate: Aiah leh Anah ahi uh.
Anah tapa Dishon ahi. Dishon tapate: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran leh Keran ahi uh.
Ezer tapate: Bilhan, Zaavan leh Jaakan ahi uh. Dishan tapate: Uz leh Aran ahi uh.
Huchi in hiaite Israel suante tung a vaihawm kumpipate himhim a-om ma ua, Edom gam a vaihawm kumpipate ahi uhi. Beor tapa Bela, akhopi min Dinhabah ahi.
heading: Edom Kumpipate / (Gen 36.31-43)

paite: Bela asi a, huchi in Bozrah a Zerah tapa Jobab in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Jobab asi a, Teman mite gam a Husham in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Husham asi a, Bedad, Moab gam a Midian mi thattu, Bedad tapa Hadad in asik in vai ahawm a; akhopi min Avith ahi.
Hadad asi a, huchi in Masrekah mi Samlah in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Samlah asi a, huchi in lui kiang a Rehoboth a Shaul in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Shaul asi a, huchi in Akbor tapa Baal-hanan in asik in vai ahawm hi.
Baal-hanan asi a, asik in Hadad in vai ahawm a, akhopi min Pai ahi; huan azi min Mehetabel, Matred tanu, Mezahab tanu ahi.
Hadad leng asi hi. Edom hausa makaite: hausa makai Timnah, hausa makai Aliah, hausa makai Jetheth,
hausa makai Aholibamah, hausa makai Elah, hausa makai Pinon,
hausa makai Kenaz, hausa makai Teman, hausa makai Mibzar,
hausa makai Magdiel, leh hausa makai Iram; hiaite Edom hausa makaite ahi uhi.
